name: Mediterranean Sea
genZNote: Three continents (Europe, Africa, Asia) all touch the Mediterranean at once — it's less a sea and more a shared backyard pool for half the Old World.

sections.heading: 🌊 Location & Ocean Connection
bullets: A large sea almost entirely enclosed by land, between Europe to the north, Africa to the south, and Asia (the Levant/Turkey) to the east.

Connects to the Atlantic Ocean through the Strait of Gibraltar in the west, to the Red Sea via the Suez Canal in the south-east, and to the Black Sea via the Bosporus and Dardanelles straits in the north-east.

sections.heading: 🗺️ Countries Bordering It
bullets: Europe: Spain, France, Italy, Greece, Croatia, and other southern European states.
North Africa: Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt.
Western Asia: Turkey, Syria, Lebanon, Israel.

sections.heading: 🚢 Ports & Trade Routes
bullets: Major ports: Valencia and Algeciras (Spain), Marseille (France), Genoa (Italy), Piraeus (Greece), Alexandria (Egypt), Port Said (Egypt, at the Suez Canal's Mediterranean end).
The main entry/exit point for Europe-Asia trade moving through the Suez Canal.
One of the busiest cruise-tourism regions in the world alongside its cargo traffic.

sections.heading: 🐠 Economic & Ecological Significance
bullets: Considered a biodiversity hotspot with high numbers of species found nowhere else, despite covering less than 1% of the world's ocean surface.
Heavily affected by overfishing, plastic pollution and shipping traffic due to its enclosed shape and dense coastal population.
Warming faster than the global ocean average, which is affecting native marine species and allowing warmer-water species to migrate in through the Suez Canal (a process called Lessepsian migration).

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: The Mediterranean Sea is a largely enclosed sea between Europe, Africa and Asia, linked to the Atlantic (Gibraltar), the Red Sea (Suez Canal) and the Black Sea (Bosporus/Dardanelles).
keyFacts: Connects to Atlantic via Gibraltar, Red Sea via Suez Canal, Black Sea via Bosporus/Dardanelles.
Major biodiversity hotspot despite small size.
Key ports: Marseille, Genoa, Piraeus, Alexandria.
commonConfusion: The Mediterranean connects to the Black Sea through TWO straits in sequence — the Dardanelles then the Bosporus (with the Sea of Marmara between them) — not one single strait.

highYieldFacts: Mediterranean touches 3 continents: Europe, Africa, Asia.
Gibraltar links it to the Atlantic; Suez Canal links it to the Red Sea.
Bosporus + Dardanelles (either side of the Sea of Marmara) link it to the Black Sea.
commonTraps: Don't merge the Bosporus and Dardanelles into a single strait — they're two separate straits with the Sea of Marmara between them.
mustRemember: Mediterranean = Europe + Africa + Asia meeting point; Gibraltar, Suez, Bosporus/Dardanelles as its three exits.
